title: Representation Selection
description: Readback lineage from a seller-bound manifest or CreativeAsset to the exact CreativeRepresentationSet revision and representation selected for it. This is selection lineage, not served-variant identity.

source_set.creative_id: must equal the source CreativeRepresentationSet creative_id
source_set.revision_id: must equal the source CreativeRepresentationSet revision_id
source_set.revision_content_digest: must equal the verified digest of the complete source CreativeRepresentationSet
source_set.selected_representation_id: must identify exactly one member of the complete source representations array
source_set.strategy: must equal the capability-advertised strategy requested for this resolution

derived_output.source_revision_unchanged: selection, macro binding, translation, and transcoding MUST NOT change the source revision binding
derived_output.canonical_content: RFC 8785 JCS of the manifest projection after removing exactly top-level $schema, representation_selection, creative_id, revision_id, name, tags, status, weight, placement_refs, placement_ids, and inputs properties; every other field, including unknown delivery fields, is included
derived_output.shared_projection: apply the same exclusion list to the returned CreativeManifest and to its later CreativeAsset sync wrapper so library metadata never changes the digest
derived_output.selected_output_digest: must equal lowercase-hex SHA-256 of derived-output canonical content before receiving-seller normalization
derived_output.review_identity: the receiving seller tracks selected_representation_id plus selected_output_digest separately from the source revision; changing either is an updated execution that follows ordinary re-review without minting a buyer revision

revision_content_digest.description: Verified digest from the complete source representation set. A downstream seller uses this value, not the selected manifest bytes alone, to enforce immutable revision reuse.

strategy.description: Deterministic strategy applied after compatibility filtering.

selected_output_digest.description: Digest of the derived seller-bound manifest projection, computed with RFC 8785 JCS after removing exactly top-level `$schema`, `representation_selection`, `creative_id`, `revision_id`, `name`, `tags`, `status`, `weight`, `placement_refs`, `placement_ids`, and `inputs`. Every other field, including unknown delivery fields, is included. The identical exclusion list applies to the returned CreativeManifest and its later CreativeAsset sync wrapper. A selected sync item cannot carry localization in this version. This is the review/execution fingerprint for the projection, distinct from revision_content_digest, which binds the complete source set.

resolved_by.description: Who performed deterministic compatibility resolution. A buyer may resolve locally from seller discovery. Seller resolution is valid only on the destination sales agent when it advertised representation_resolution; an independent creative agent cannot claim seller-bound compatibility.
